A security review will always see the behaviors below — here is what each one is for and where its"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"iew will always see the behaviors below — here is what each one is for and where its boundaries are:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- **Running shell commands**: install/update/uninstall means running pnpm. The market only runs the "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"pnpm/curl/wget/powershell commands it assembles itself; during install, pnpm runs the plugin's own p"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"repare/postinstall scripts (standard behavior for every package manager) — the market scans those sc"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"ripts first and warns ahead of time about network downloads or high-risk patterns.
- **Reading git c"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"redentials**: used in exactly two places — starring a repo and the "set GitHub token" feature. Crede"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"ntials only go to api.github.com; they are never written to disk, logged, or sent anywhere else.
- *"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"*The gh-proxy.com mirror**: only as a fallback when a direct GitHub request fails, and only for publ"},{"id":"p30s8","text":"ic repository metadata. A plugin's own network behavior after install has nothing to do with the mir"},{"id":"p30s9","text":"ror.
- **Reading/writing profile files**: install/uninstall/toggle must edit the profile's package.j"},{"id":"p30s10","text":"son etc. Every change is backed up to `zat-backup/` first, and failed operations restore automatical"},{"id":"p30s11","text":"ly.
- **Pre-install health + security scan**: every candidate and every installed plugin is scanned "},{"id":"p30s12","text":"for structural, dependency, and security patterns (obfuscation, credential theft, suspicious exfiltr"},{"id":"p30s13","text":"ation, system modification), with all network destinations listed before install; security findings "},{"id":"p30s14","text":"only warn (never block), while objective issues like missing entries or unsupported OS are blocked."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Each of these is the minimal permission set required for the market to work; if a review questions a"},{"id":"p31s2","text":" specific behavior, this section is the reference."}],"truncated":true}
